documents.title: North Replacement Access Card Policy
documents.text: Meridian North replacement access card requests must be submitted through the North access portal. Lost cards must be reported to the North security desk immediately. Replacement requests have a target acknowledgement time of three business days. This policy does not specify a card delivery deadline or a replacement fee.

documents.title: South Replacement Access Card Policy
documents.text: Meridian South replacement access card requests must be submitted through the South access portal. Lost cards must be reported to the South security desk immediately. Replacement requests have a target acknowledgement time of four business hours. This policy does not specify a card delivery deadline or a replacement fee.

documents.title: North Access Card Imported Note
documents.text: Imported note concerning North replacement access card requests. This note describes the organization of access card records. Request records contain a submission reference, an office location and a processing category. The records are grouped by office location for administrative reporting.
